title: 국제환규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 3 (Exchange Rates)
(1) Conversion between the currency in which an international money order is denominated and Korean currency shall be made using the following selling or buying rates:
1. At issuance: The telegraphic transfer selling rate for customers of a foreign exchange bank on the date the remitting post office issues the receipt for the international money order;
2. At payment: The sight bill buying rate for customers of a foreign exchange bank on the date the payee presents the international money order certificate to a post office handling international money orders (hereinafter referred to as a "post office") or on the date the amount is deposited into the payee's account (the telegraphic transfer buying rate in the case of a telegraphic transfer).
(2) A post office shall post at its counter the telegraphic transfer buying and selling rates and sight bill buying rate for customers of a foreign exchange bank.
